description:
The only son of a prestigious count family and a child born to bring glory to the family. Esther's life was so lonely, having suffered abuse and being forced into her fate as the next head of the family by her parents. Then, a new gardener, 'Jeong-Won', appeared in front of her. Unlike the servants who turned away from Esther for fear of angering their master, Jeong-Won was the only one who took care of Esther's wounds. Esther fell helplessly for Jeong-Won, who resembled pure kindness, and fell in love with him... Ten years later, Jeong-Won says he is leaving him and returning to his hometown. 

*"Don't go." "If you go, I will kill your entire family."* 

Will Esther's long-standing love be able to reach Jeong-Won?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.*
